finding.claim: The /logo handler fetches an arbitrary attacker-supplied URL with the default http.Get client after a substring check (strings.Contains(raw, "example.io")) that does not constrain the host. The full response body is copied back to the attacker, so this is non-blind SSRF that can reach internal services and cloud metadata.
finding.source: main.go:31 raw := r.FormValue("logo") (query string or form body, unauthenticated)
finding.sink: main.go:36 resp, _ := http.Get(raw), followed by main.go:38 io.Copy(w, resp.Body) reflecting the response

trace.note: Attacker-controlled input read from the 'logo' parameter with r.FormValue. No auth check in the handler.
Only validator: strings.Contains(raw, "example.io"). This is a substring match over the whole raw URL, not a host check, so the host can be anything as long as the string appears somewhere.
http.Get(raw) re-parses the same unmodified string with the default client. The client follows up to 10 redirects, has no timeout, and does no IP or DNS filtering.
defer resp.Body.Close() runs before the error is checked. The error is discarded at line 36, so a failed request leaves resp nil and this line panics.
io.Copy streams the internal response body to the attacker. No status or size limit is applied, so this is a read-back SSRF.

finding.guards_checked: Only the substring check at main.go:32. Confirmed absent: host allowlist, parsed-hostname check, scheme allowlist, resolved-IP blocklist, DNS pinning, redirect restriction (default client follows redirects), response size or content-type limit. Go's http.Get rejects non-http(s) schemes, so file:// and gopher:// are not reachable. Example inputs that pass the check and reach internal targets: logo=http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/?example.io (the query string satisfies the substring check) and logo=http://example.io@169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ (userinfo carries the substring). Also logo=http://example.io.attacker.test/ and a public URL that redirects to an internal address pass the check and are followed. I did not send any of these requests.

verdict.guard_found: none. The only check in the /logo path is the substring test at main.go:32 (strings.Contains(raw, "example.io")), which does not constrain the parsed host. The exact-hostname allowlist (trusted map, main.go:10, checked at main.go:20) and the noRedirect client (main.go:12, 24) belong to the separate /cdn handler and are not applied to the /logo path, which calls the default http.Get at main.go:36.
verdict.reason: The "logo" parameter is read unauthenticated at main.go:31, passes only the substring check at main.go:32, is fetched with the default client at main.go:36, and the full body is returned to the caller via io.Copy at main.go:38, so the SSRF is non-blind and unguarded. All trace lines match the file, including the nil-resp panic at main.go:37 when http.Get fails.
